canvas_juggler_subrole_descriptions.ring: 👁️ **Me-tsuke (目付)** - The circle of surveillance that maintains order in the district

ring.title: 👁️ **ME-TSUKE (目付)** 👁️
ring.description: 🔍 The surveillance circle. As district inspector, Yuki maintains a network of contacts that allows interrogation and pursuit without breaking the tea house's discretion.
ring.status_active: ✅ **ACTIVE SURVEILLANCE** - Yuki is exercising her inspector function
ring.investigation_instructions:
• Use **Me-tsuke: Point** from the menu below
• Write the mention (@) or ID of the suspected visitor
• Yuki will initiate a direct inquiry
• The result will be visible to all in the channel
ring.investigation_warning:
⚠️ **RESTRICTIONS:**
• A visitor cannot point to themselves
• Bots are not subjects of investigation
• Surveillance must be activated by an administrator
ring.inactive_instructions:
To activate surveillance:
• An administrator must access the **Admin Me-tsuke** panel
• Execute **Surveillance: Activate**
• Configure the frequency of rounds

Once active, you can point to suspected visitors.
ring.controls:
**Controls**
- Activate or deactivate surveillance
- Round frequency
ring.admin_description: Configure sensitivity and frequency of the Me-tsuke surveillance

dropdown.ring_accuse_description: Indicate that a visitor is suspect for investigation
